name: Quilt
author: support@phosphor.host
description: Quilt Server. Quilt is a lightweight mod loader for Minecraft based on Fabric Loader, with support for snapshots and fast updates to new versions.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Minecraft Installation Script (MCJars)
# https://mcjars.app — Server Files: /mnt/server
TYPE=QUILT
API_BASE="${MCJARS_API_BASE:-https://versions.mcjars.app}"
USER_AGENT="${MCJARS_USER_AGENT:-EnderHosting-Hydrodactyl/1.0 (https://enderhosting.pro)}"
SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"

set -e

resolve_version() {
	if [ -n "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] && [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" != "latest" ]; then
		echo "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
		return
	fi
	if [ -n "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" ] && [ "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" != "latest" ]; then
		echo "${VELOCITY_VERSION}"
		return
	fi
	echo "latest"
}

pick_build() {
	# Prints JSON object for the selected build from .builds array
	local json="$1"
	local build="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

	if [ -z "$json" ] || [ "$json" = "null" ]; then
		echo ""
		return
	fi

	if [ -z "$build" ] || [ "$build" = "latest" ]; then
		echo "$json" | jq -c '(.builds // []) | .[0] // empty'
		return
	fi

	echo "$json" | jq -c --arg b "$build" '
		(.builds // [])
		| map(select(
			(.buildNumber|tostring) == $b
			or (.name|tostring) == $b
			or (.name|tostring) == ("#" + $b)
		))
		| .[0] // empty
	'
}

run_installation_steps() {
	local build_json="$1"
	# Flatten installation: array of step-groups → each group is array of actions
	echo "$build_json" | jq -c '
		[.installation // [] | .[] | .[]]
		| .[]
	' | while IFS= read -r step; do
		stype=$(echo "$step" | jq -r '.type // empty')
		case "$stype" in
			download)
				url=$(echo "$step" | jq -r '.url')
				file=$(echo "$step" | jq -r '.file // "server.jar"')
				echo "Downloading ${file}"
				curl -fL -A "${USER_AGENT}" -o "${file}" "${url}"
				;;
			unzip)
				file=$(echo "$step" | jq -r '.file')
				loc=$(echo "$step" | jq -r '.location // "."')
				echo "Unzipping ${file} → ${loc}"
				unzip -o "${file}" -d "${loc}"
				;;
			remove)
				loc=$(echo "$step" | jq -r '.location // empty')
				if [ -n "$loc" ]; then
					echo "Removing ${loc}"
					rm -rf "${loc}"
				fi
				;;
			*)
				echo "WARN: unknown installation step type: ${stype}"
				;;
		esac
	done
}

cd /mnt/server
apk add --no-cache curl jq unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
	curl -fL -A "${USER_AGENT}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
else
	VERSION="$(resolve_version)"
	echo -e "Resolving ${TYPE} via MCJars (version=${VERSION}, build=${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest})"

	if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
		PAYLOAD=$(curl -fsSL -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API_BASE}/api/v2/builds/${TYPE}/latest") || {
			echo "ERROR: failed to query MCJars latest builds for ${TYPE}"
			exit 1
		}
		VERSION=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.builds[0].versionId // .builds[0].projectVersionId // "latest"')
	else
		PAYLOAD=$(curl -fsSL -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API_BASE}/api/v2/builds/${TYPE}/${VERSION}") || {
			echo "WARN: version ${VERSION} not found for ${TYPE}, falling back to latest"
			PAYLOAD=$(curl -fsSL -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API_BASE}/api/v2/builds/${TYPE}/latest") || {
				echo "ERROR: failed to query MCJars latest builds for ${TYPE}"
				exit 1
			}
			VERSION=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.builds[0].versionId // .builds[0].projectVersionId // "latest"')
		}
	fi

	BUILD_JSON=$(pick_build "$PAYLOAD")
	if [ -z "$BUILD_JSON" ] || [ "$BUILD_JSON" = "null" ]; then
		echo "ERROR: no matching build for ${TYPE} ${VERSION}"
		exit 1
	fi

	JAR_URL=$(echo "$BUILD_JSON" | jq -r '.jarUrl // empty')
	HAS_INSTALL=$(echo "$BUILD_JSON" | jq -r '(.installation | length) // 0')

	if [ -n "$JAR_URL" ] && [ "$JAR_URL" != "null" ]; then
		echo -e "Downloading ${TYPE}"
		echo -e "Version: ${VERSION:-unknown}"
		echo -e "URL: ${JAR_URL}"
		if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
			mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
		fi
		curl -fL -A "${USER_AGENT}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${JAR_URL}"
		SIZE=$(wc -c < "${SERVER_JARFILE}" | tr -d ' ')
		if [ "${SIZE}" -lt 50000 ]; then
			echo "ERROR: downloaded file is too small (${SIZE} bytes)."
			head -c 200 "${SERVER_JARFILE}" || true
			echo
			exit 1
		fi
	elif [ "$HAS_INSTALL" != "0" ]; then
		echo -e "Running MCJars installation steps for ${TYPE} ${VERSION}"
		run_installation_steps "$BUILD_JSON"
		# Prefer a produced server jar if present
		if [ ! -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
			if [ -f server.jar ]; then
				:
			elif ls *.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
				FIRST=$(ls *.jar | head -n1)
				cp "$FIRST" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
			fi
		fi
	else
		echo "ERROR: could not resolve download for ${TYPE}"
		exit 1
	fi
fi

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
	echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
	curl -fsSL -A "${USER_AGENT}" -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties || true
fi

echo -e "Installation complete"
